How far an electric cargo tricycle gets: Ukuthi ibhayisikili lempahla elinamasondo amathathu likagesi lingaya libuye kude kangakanani ngokushaja ibhethri kanye, emagqumeni futhi likhetha imizila yamabhayisikili, nokuthi longa malini uma liqhathaniswa nemoto (ukuthenga, uphethiloli, intela, umshwalense, ukupaka, ukulungisa), kuthebhu yalo.
Round trip from a start point to a desti: Uhambo lokuya nokubuya kusuka endaweni yokuqala kuya lapho uya khona emigwaqweni esebenziseka ngebhayisikili (likhetha imizila yamabhayisikili) nebhethri elisetshenziswe ezweni, kanye nemephu yebanga ebonisa ukuthi ibhayisikili lingaya libuye kude kangakanani kuzo zonke izinhlangothi.
Yearly cost of the cargo bike against a: Izindleko zonyaka zebhayisikili lempahla uma ziqhathaniswa nemoto ohambweni olufanayo: ukuthenga, amandla, intela, umshwalense, ukupaka nokulungisa, ngemali yezwe lendawo yokuqala.
